scope: Original attributed narrated survey of Klamath Llao and Skell heart story and a distinct Giiwas creation account; named source version rather than composite canonical myth.

cultural_attribution.custodians: Klamath storytellers, knowledge holders and the living Klamath Tribes; named prior narrators Robert David, Chief Lalek (reported by Colvig), Perry Chocktoot; versions from Modoc also exist and are not treated as interchangeable Klamath texts
cultural_attribution.narration_status: Original educational commentary and paraphrase only; not an approved Klamath-language translation or community-authorized performance
cultural_attribution.primary_witness_status: Barker Klamath Texts (1963) 71–75 located bibliographically but full pages NOT inspected; main sequence grounded in Winthrop/Crater Lake Institute and Rostock synopses
cultural_attribution.versions: Robert David as mediated through 1997 synopsis; Applegate 1907 (Antelope/Eagle/Dove); Trager 1939 (Coyote/Fox and louse ruse); Perry Chocktoot contemporary fire-and-collapse account; Colvig late manuscripts identified as separate
cultural_attribution.permissions_boundary: No claim of rights to reproduce Klamath original text, oral performances, songs, ceremonies, or voice; originally authored narration is distinct from a traditional performance
cultural_attribution.dating_boundary: 7700-year geology vs. publication and recorded transmission dates; no assertion of 7700-year verbatim text
cultural_attribution.future_primary_review: Read and compare Barker 1963 pp.71–75 before claiming definitive retelling of Robert David; consult Klamath knowledge holders for approved distribution of a community-version rendition
